title: Sprint Zipper deploy slate and ops annotated (2027-07)
body:
Context:
This is a working doc for the "sprint zipper" pattern: small feature cohorts from three squads are grouped and deployed together in a tightly coordinated 6-hour window to reduce repeated toil and consolidate telemetry sampling. We call it a zipper because individual micro-rollouts are interleaved (stitch + unzip if rollback needed).

Goals for this run:
- minimize blast radius per feature while reducing total ops overhead
- get statistically meaningful telemetry for each cohort with a shared smoke/aftershock sampling plan
- exercise cross-region fallback routing and model-variant fallback

High-level timeline (UTC):
- T-72h: freeze cross-squad merges to main for zipper bundle (status: soft-freeze)
- T-48h: CI perf/signature runs complete; docs + release notes draft available
- T-24h: dry-run in canary cluster (low-traffic) with synthetic replay; verify KV cache behavior
- T-6h: preflight call (all leads), final go/no-go sync, update pager duty staggers
- T+0: zipper start — sequential cohort gates (A -> B -> C) with 10m ramp each and 30m observation windows
- T+3h: full regional traffic migration for cohort A and B (if green), cohort C stays limited to 5%
- T+6h: post-flight retrospective notes populated, flags/rollbacks scheduled if issues

Preflight checklist (owner initials):
- Code/PRs merged and green (PR owners)
- Migrations validated and feature flags annotated (DB lead)
- Model variant pin(s) confirmed & canary variants available (ML infra)
- Capacity reservation checked in Dedicated clusters (infra ops)
- Alerting runbooks for new signals added to Ops binder (SRE)
- Release notes draft and user-impact blurb ready (PM)
- Communication channel: #release-zipper + Zoom bridge set (Communications)
- Canary traffic profile and synthetic replay scripts queued (QE)

Staffing matrix (hourly blocks):
- Owner (Maya R): overall conductor, final decisions
- SRE: 1 primary (Ethan P), 1 secondary (Lina Z) — 6h watch
- Serving runtime lead: Carlos M — available T-6h through T+3h
- ML infra: Lina Z — T-24h to T+6h
- Product & PM: Janice K — T-48h to T+6h for impact comms
- On-call rotation: fallback handoff at T+2h and T+5h (staggered)

Cohort gating plan (technical gate + health metrics):
Cohort A (feature set alpha): 10m ramp, health window 30m. Gate requires:
- 99.9th percentile latency not increasing > 20% vs baseline
- error rate delta < 0.05% absolute
- token throughput within capacity plan +/- 10%
If gate fails: immediate 100% revert for cohort A, pause zipper, run postmortem stub.

Cohort B (non-critical UI tweaks + reranking model): 15m ramp, health window 30m. Gate requires:
- reranking precision metrics within expected range (internal evals): AUC delta < 0.02
- backend latency stable, spotting prefix-cache miss rate < 5%

Cohort C (experiment + new batching path): 20m ramp, health window 60m. Gate requires:
- throughput and batching rate within target, no spike in OOMs
- quantized path cold-start < 1s additional latency per request

Telemetry sampling and signal catalog (quick reference):
- Synthetic replay timeseries: token/s, p50/p95/p99 latencies, error counts
- Business signals: conversion funnels (feature-specific events) for cohorts A/B/C
- Regression probes: hallucination rate probe for reranking model (automated eval harness)
- Resource signals: GPU mem pressure, kernel queue length, KV cache hit ratio
- Canary tags: region, instance-type, model-variant, rollout-cohort

Communication script (short):
- Preflight DM template to execs: "Starting zipper window at T+0 UTC. Expect incremental cohort ramps A-B-C. On-call leads listed. Will share first 30m observation note."
- Incident opener: "Rolling back cohort <name> due to <signal>. Reverting feature flag and model pining. ETA for re-eval: 60m."

Rollback matrix (quick):
- Fast rollback: feature-flag flip + model pin revert (target < 2 minutes to effect in-region)
- Slow rollback: regional traffic shift away from variant via smart routing (10-30m ramp)
- Emergency: global shutdown of zipper path; fall back to baseline model variant with autoscaling disabled for dehydrated path

Post-flight artifacts to capture (owners):
- Populated release notes template: short summary + user-facing impact (PM)
- Observability snapshot: p50/p95/p99 delta graphs + annotated anomalies (SRE)
- Regression log: any eval failures and candidate mitigations (ML)
- Retrospective doc: what went well / what we should change next zipper (Owner)

Release notes draft (copyable blurb):
- Headline: "Multi-cohort sprint zipper: A/B/C feature rollouts — July 2027"
- Summary: "This release introduces a reranking model update (Cohort B), UI changes to the generator flow (Cohort A), and an experimental batching execution path (Cohort C). These were deployed in a coordinated zipper to reduce churn and consolidate telemetry sampling. No user-facing downtime expected."
- Known issues: "Cohort C may observe slightly slower cold-starts on some quantized nodes; mitigations underway."

Open questions / TODOs (notes to self):
- Should we increase baseline sampling on weekends to catch different traffic patterns? (ask analytics)
- Validate rollback propagation time for feature flags across regions — observed 3-4m in last test; target <2m
- Add explicit smoke check for KV cache eviction ripple when mixing model variants

Quick references / bookmarks:
- Canaries: cluster-canary-1.redwood.internal
- Telemetry dashboard (sample): https://grafana.redwood/zipper-telemetry
- Replay job: job/zipper-synthetic-replay-2027-07
- Post-deploy retrospective template: CONFLUENCE:RELEASE-RETRO-TEMPLATE

If anything is unclear call out in the preflight meeting. Marking this doc as the annotated ops slate for the sprint zipper run on 2027-07-15 (expected execution).
